E: For a valid endpoint v, full-rectangle arbitrary-start DP F(v)=C(x+y+2,x+1)-1.
Every full path ending at a valid vertex that is invalid for the punctured rectangle has a unique first forbidden vertex h.
First-entry source weight H_h is 1 for starting at h, plus full unaffected predecessor DP from the left boundary x=L and bottom boundary y=D.
Suffix count from h to any valid endpoint is F(W-hx,H-hy)-F(R-hx,U-hy).
Double sums of F over rectangles collapse by hockey-stick identities; only O(width+height) weighted boundary loops remain.
B: After first touching pile i, its remaining A_i-1 decrements are indistinguishable pass moves; state is unopened set plus total pass tokens T.
With two unopened piles, outcome is T mod 2. The three-unopened classification follows directly by one opening into that base.
For four unopened piles, direct recurrence gives outcome parity(T) XOR parity(number of even b_i), b_i=A_i-1.
For m>=5, opening any pile from T=0 produces the opposite parity class in the m-1 formula; for T>0 the pass move toggles it. Hence initial N>=4 winner iff the number of odd A_i is odd.
C: Let a=P1<b=P2 and T=query(1,2). For p<a, q2>T and q1-q2=-(T-A_a); for a<p<b both q1,q2<T and d=q1-q2 is strictly increasing with p; for p>b, q1>T and d=T-A_b.
Therefore labels split into left/middle/right and their exact positional order is recovered by q1 descending, d ascending, q1 ascending respectively, with labels 1 and 2 inserted between groups.
Middle A values equal q1+q2-T. Consecutive left q1 differences and right q2 differences recover all non-anchor A values; nearest outside or nearest middle equations recover anchor A values.

C.input: N=5000 random hidden permutation and A
C.frozen_complexity: O(N log N) local work; 2N-3 queries

x1_reason: No frozen M0 correctness failure and no constraint failure.
